layout: transform
name: ral, monsoon mage
mana cost: {1}{R}
types: legendary creature human wizard
power toughness: 1/3
triggered: whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell during your turn, flip a coin. if you lose the flip, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to you. if you win the flip, you may exile CARDNAME. if you do, return him to the battlefield transformed under his owner's control.
static: instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.

ALTERNATE

name: ral, leyline prodigy
types: legendary planeswalker ral
loyalty: 2
replacement: CARDNAME enters with an additional loyalty counter on him for each instant and sorcery spell you've cast this turn.
planeswalker[1]: [+1]: until your next turn, instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
planeswalker[2]: [-2]: CARDNAME deals 2 damage divided as you choose among one or two targets. draw a card if you control a blue permanent other than CARDNAME.
planeswalker[3]: [-8]: exile the top eight cards of your library. you may cast instant and sorcery spells from among them this turn without paying their mana costs.
replacement: CARDNAME enters with two loyalty counters on it.
